entries=[]
for ln in lines:
    m = entry_pattern.match(ln.strip())
    if not m:
        continue
    title=m.group(1).strip()
    artists=[a.strip() for a in m.group(2).split(',')]
    released=m.group(3).strip()
    artists_str=', '.join(artists)
    entries.append({'line':ln.strip(),'title':title,'artists':artists,'artists_str':artists_str,'released':released})

print('entries', len(entries))

# Build lookup of liked songs by (title, artists_str)
liked_lookup={}
for s in all_liked:
    a_str=', '.join([a['name'].strip() for a in s.get('artists',[])])
    key=(s['title'].strip(), a_str)
    liked_lookup.setdefault(key,[]).append(s)

# Determine TODO entries
todo_entries=[e for e in entries if e['released'].upper()=='TODO']

import re

# Build mapping from note entry key to song_id
key_to_song_id={}
for (e,key,cand) in songs_to_update:
    key_to_song_id[key]=cand['song_id']

# Build mapping song_id -> release month/year string
song_id_to_month={}
for r in release_info:
    dt=r['release_date']
    if not dt:
        continue
    # parse ISO datetime
    year=int(dt[0:4])
    month=int(dt[5:7])
    song_id_to_month[r['song_id']] = f"{month}/{year}"

print('song_id_to_month', song_id_to_month)

# Update note content lines
new_lines=[]
entry_pattern = re.compile(r'^- (.+?) BY (.+?) RELEASED_AT (.+)$')
for ln in note['content'].splitlines():
    m=entry_pattern.match(ln.strip())
    if not m:
        new_lines.append(ln)
        continue
    title=m.group(1).strip()
    artists_str=m.group(2).strip()
    released=m.group(3).strip()
    if released.upper()=='TODO':
        key=(title, artists_str)
        sid = key_to_song_id.get(key)
        if sid is None or sid not in song_id_to_month:
            new_lines.append(ln)
            print('MISSING_FOR', key, sid)
        else:
            new_ln = f"- {title} BY {artists_str} RELEASED_AT {song_id_to_month[sid]}"
            new_lines.append(new_ln)
    else:
        new_lines.append(ln)

new_content='\n'.join(new_lines)

# verify
old_todo = sum(1 for e in entries if e['released'].upper()=='TODO')
new_todo = len(re.findall(r'RELEASED_AT\s+TODO', new_content))
print('old_todo', old_todo, 'new_todo', new_todo)

# show updated bullets
updated_bullets=[ln for ln in new_content.splitlines() if ln.strip().startswith('- ')]
print('updated_bullets')
print('\n'.join(updated_bullets))

# write update
resp = apis.simple_note.update_note(note_id=liked_note_id, access_token=simple_token, content=new_content)
print('update_resp', resp)
